claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_critical_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Adamantine Armor is a passive magic item whose deterministic mechanical effect changes incoming critical hits into normal hits while worn. The existing surface has `modify_crit_range`, but that only changes the threshold for attacks you make to score a critical hit; it does not express suppressing crit status on attacks made against the wearer.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.
